page.overview:
Who is Etrogar?

Etrogar was a Warpsmith of the Iron Warriors Traitor Legion. He commanded the Iron Warriors contingent that took part in the Talledus War fought in the Talledus System of the Veritus Sub-sector under the command of the Dark Cardinal Kor Phaeron of the Word Bearers.

Etrogar unleashed upon the Fortress World of Ghreddask the daemonic fortress-factory known as a Soul Harvester that was named Scarax Krond.

When Kor Phaeron offered the Iron Warriors the chance to invade the Talledus System, the Iron Warriors warband commanded by Etrogar were tasked with containing the Imperial forces at Ghreddask, the system's formidably defended Fortress World.

The warpsmith saw the outer planets of the Talledus System as the perfect testing ground for newly perfected monstrosities -- the Soul Harvesters.
